acip: CHOS BZHI BSTAN PA'I MDO LAS STOBS BZHI DANG LDAN NA BYAS SHING BSAGS PA'I, SDIG PA THAMS CAD 'DAG PAR GSUNGS PAS LAS KYI SGRIB PA SBYANG BAR 'DOD PAS NI GNYEN PO STOBS BZHI LA 'BAD PAR BYA'O
wylie: chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las stobs bzhi dang ldan na byas shing bsags pa'i, sdig pa thams cad 'dag par gsungs pas las kyi sgrib pa sbyang bar 'dod pas ni gnyen po stobs bzhi la 'bad par bya'o
english: The Sutra on the Four Practices states that, if a person keeps the four practices, then they can purify themselves of every bad deed which they may have committed and collected. Thus we can say that, if you hope to clean yourself of the spiritual obstacles created by your past bad deeds, you should make great efforts in the four antidote powers.
